description: Canonical registry of Arkret-defined MLS (RFC 9420) GroupContext extensions occupying the MLS private-use ExtensionType range 0xF000-0xFFFF. Maintained so SDKs and conformance tooling have a single machine-readable entry for each active Arkret MLS extension codepoint.

private_use_range.reference: RFC 9420 §17.6; IANA MLS Extension Types registry (private-use range)

extensions.name: mls_governance_binding
extensions.carries: Arkret Realm/Circle governance binding inside the MLS GroupContext
